title: Cherry Backport for Environmental
description: Backports the 1.20 cherry woodset to Environmental
body:
# Vanilla Cherry Wood for Environmental
This resourcepack backports the 1.20 vanilla cherry woodset to 1.19 [Environmental](https://modrinth.com/mod/environmental)

![A screenshot of a lovely Blossom Woods biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e647ed96f989fb57e4b91be2fc78a849ba39043f.png)

## Supported mods
These mods' textures have also been included for compatibility:
- Boatload
- Woodworks
- Abnormals Delights (textures from Farmer's Delights)
